status_notes: Founded in British Columbia in 1906, Avalon Dairy is no longer solely family-owned. Canada's Investment Canada Act records identify a 2016 acquisition involving Beijing Sanyuan Foods Co., Ltd. of China. Beijing Sanyuan's August 2026 interim report continues to consolidate Avalon Dairy Limited and Crowley Properties Limited as Canadian subsidiaries with 51% interests at the subsidiary tier. Sanyuan identifies Beijing Shounong Food Group as its ultimate parent. Avalon is Canadian-founded and Canadian-operated, but is foreign-controlled.

Avalon Dairy conducts dairy processing in Burnaby, British Columbia, and describes using local dairy inputs. This supports Canadian production of its dairy lines but does not establish that all Avalon-branded goods meet CFIA's product-specific Made in Canada or Product of Canada criteria. Verify the manufacturing site, milk and ingredient origin, and applicable label for each SKU before enabling either badge. Canadian processing does not establish Canadian ownership.

status_notes: Tim Hortons is owned by Restaurant Brands International (RBI), a publicly traded Canadian corporation. RBI has international shareholders, including a significant stake held by 3G Capital-related funds, so majority Canadian beneficial ownership cannot be confirmed. Tim Hortons itself is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.
